description: Search Google Shopping, look up products by ID, or browse deals and categories. Returns real product IDs, viewer URLs, seller offers with shipping and totals, price ranges and 12-month price history where Google exposes it.

category.description: Google Shopping department for category mode.
category.title: Category

condition.description: Condition hint sent to Google and verified when the result card shows a condition.
condition.title: Condition

countryCode.description: Country used for the Google domain, UULE location and price hint. The actual currency is always detected from the response, never relabelled.
countryCode.title: Country

freeShipping.description: Ask Google for free-shipping products and keep rows whose delivery text says free.
freeShipping.title: Free Shipping Only

includePriceHistory.description: Include per-seller daily price history when Google exposes it (product mode and search detail enrichment).
includePriceHistory.title: Include 12-Month Price History

includeProductDetails.description: Fetch the product viewer for each search result to add brand, description, images, specifications and offers. Costs one extra request per result.
includeProductDetails.title: Enrich Search Results

maxPrice.description: Maximum price in the detected local currency. Applied through a shoprs filter and verified on every output row.
maxPrice.title: Maximum Price

maxResultsPerQuery.description: Maximum records per query (search/deals/category) or products (product mode).
maxResultsPerQuery.title: Max Results

minPrice.description: Minimum price in the detected local currency. Applied through a shoprs filter and verified on every output row.
minPrice.title: Minimum Price

minRating.description: Minimum product rating (0-5). Applied through a shoprs rating chip and verified on every output row.
minRating.title: Minimum Rating

mode.description: What to collect: keyword search, product lookup by ID/viewer URL, deals, or a department category.
mode.title: Mode

onSale.description: Ask Google for discounted products and keep rows with an observed original price or discount.
onSale.title: On Sale Only

productIds.description: Google Shopping catalog IDs, product IDs, product viewer URLs, or legacy /shopping/product/<id> URLs. Used in product mode.
productIds.title: Product IDs or Viewer URLs

queries.description: Product keywords for search/deals mode. Ignored in product mode; optional in category mode.
queries.title: Search Queries

sortBy.description: Client-side sort of the collected rows. Google ignores server-side sort on this page.
sortBy.title: Sort By

store.description: Optional store name to bias and verify, e.g. Best Buy or Amazon.
store.title: Store

title: Google Shopping Price Comparison & Deal Finder
